requirement_corrections.original: V24 accepted zero-width exposed right-eye viewports with stereo preview off
requirement_corrections.correction: Expose positive nonoverlapping view regions in both settings; select the left completed image through presentation policy
requirement_corrections.rationale: Every exposed view must have a usable bounded region. Custom per-eye pixels and projections verify both settings.

requirement_corrections.original: Native opaque resources were broadly described as unenforceable
requirement_corrections.correction: Implement owned allocation and ordinary WebGL guards; bound the native-isolation claim to measured hostile page interference
requirement_corrections.rationale: Ordinary access protections pass. A pristine same-origin about:blank iframe native attachment getter returns the owned color texture with NO_ERROR on all three configurations. The probe measures inspection only. Native browser support or a separately isolated renderer are alternatives for stronger isolation.

requirement_corrections.original: Application canvas resizing should resize immersive layer storage (prior fixtures)
requirement_corrections.correction: XRWebGLLayer storage remains fixed; new layers use current recommendations, and existing projection storage stays independent of canvas writes
requirement_corrections.reference: Device CRD 11.2 immutable owned framebuffer dimensions
requirement_corrections.rationale: Retain meaningful resize/pixel checks for fixed resources instead of default-framebuffer coupling.

adaptation: The seven pinned WPT HTML files were inspected, not executed verbatim. tests/webgl-layer.ts adapts applicable assertions to real extension sessions, deterministic odd recommendations and emulator scale policy; it adds resource, pixel and lifecycle coverage. Native fake-device/activation/native-scale infrastructure is not tested. The existing five-file test:wpt selection remains unchanged.
intermediate_failures_resolved: WebGL2 default-output presentation initially failed for multisampled default buffers; replaced the blit observation copy with a fullscreen draw.
Mono preview initially composited the selected semi-transparent eye over existing output; replacement copy now preserves alpha.
Old retained-projection resize and AR canvas-count assumptions failed; updated to assert independent fixed storage, retained pixels and untouched application canvas.
Test context union inference and non-nullable TypeScript fault-injection signatures initially failed typecheck; corrected before successful build.
known_client_failure: Official Three.js 0.186.1 depth-disabled WebXRManager still throws its existing THREE.DepthTexture error after successful XR projection allocation. Fixtures verify usable depthless XR resources but do not call that client failure successful application rendering. Depth-enabled Three.js projection mesh pixels pass with and without the layers feature on all three configurations.
limits_and_skips: No new official WebXR Samples application execution; optional pinned immersive VR sample was not run.
No Firefox runtime or physical-device execution; these remain separate goal work.
No unmodified/native fake-device WPT suite execution; seven resource files are adapted in the real-extension harness.
Six existing ordinary-page shared-buffer skips remain because those pages are not cross-origin isolated; the separate isolated shared-buffer fixture passed 49 assertions.
WebGL1 immersive antialiasing is reported false; WebGL2 multisampling is allocated and pixel-verified. This is a documented implementation capability, not a skipped AA assertion.
Presentation uses CPU readback/row conversion/upload to a separate canvas; native compositor timing, hostile-page-proof isolation and GPU throughput are not claimed.
